Junior Content Creator & Video Editor – Social Media

**Company:** Bright Blizz Innovations Private Limited  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Arrangement:** On-site for full-time employees; project-based for freelancers  
**Initial Full-Time Salary:** ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month, subject to applicable minimum-wage requirements  
**Experience:** 0–2 years preferred  
**Initial Performance Review:** After 3 months

About Bright Blizz Innovations

Bright Blizz Innovations Private Limited is an emerging creative, digital marketing and technology company delivering branding, performance marketing, website development, social media management and digital transformation solutions.

We work with businesses across different industries, transforming their ideas into meaningful brand experiences through strategy, technology and creative execution.

As we strengthen our content-production capabilities, we are looking for a creative professional who can bring original ideas to life through compelling visuals, engaging storytelling and purposeful digital content.

We believe creativity is not merely about following trends. It is about understanding audiences, communicating ideas effectively and producing work that creates measurable value for brands.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a **Junior Content Creator & Video Editor** who is passionate about visual storytelling, videography, editing and social media.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable participating in the complete content-production process, from understanding a creative brief and developing concepts to shooting, editing and preparing content for publication.

This is a hands-on creative position with opportunities to develop broader responsibilities as skills and experience grow.

We value candidates who demonstrate initiative, accountability and a genuine desire to improve their craft.

Key Responsibilities1. Creative Research & Content Development

* Research relevant social media trends, audience interests and competitor content.
* Assist in developing original content concepts for client brands.
* Prepare short-form video scripts, creative hooks and basic storyboards.
* Understand brand guidelines and adapt content to different target audiences.
* Participate in planning content calendars and campaign-related creative requirements.

2. Videography & Content Production

* Plan and execute short-form video shoots at the office and approved client locations.
* Capture product footage, business environments, promotional videos, interviews and behind-the-scenes content.
* Apply appropriate framing, composition, lighting and basic audio-recording techniques.
* Prepare simple shot lists and organise footage for editing.
* Handle assigned production equipment responsibly.

3. Video Editing & Post-Production

* Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional social media videos.
* Add captions, subtitles, transitions, basic motion graphics and appropriate sound design.
* Perform basic colour correction and audio adjustments.
* Optimise video formats for different social media platforms.
* Maintain organised project files, raw footage and final exports.
* Complete approved revisions within agreed timelines.

4. Social Media Content Coordination

* Support the preparation of monthly social media content calendars.
* Draft captions, hashtags and post descriptions.
* Prepare approved creative assets for publishing.
* Schedule content through authorised social media management tools.
* Review basic engagement metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate content approvals with the Project & Operations Manager.

5. Creative Ownership & Professional Accountability

* Take responsibility for assigned creative deliverables from briefing to completion.
* Communicate progress, requirements and potential delays proactively.
* Maintain consistency in creative quality and brand presentation.
* Suggest practical ideas to improve content effectiveness and production efficiency.
* Collaborate professionally with clients and internal team members.
* Support the development of Bright Blizz's own creative portfolio and social media presence.

Required Skills

* Practical knowledge of video shooting and editing.
* Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or equivalent editing tools.
* Basic understanding of camera composition, lighting and audio recording.
* Knowledge of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and common social media content formats.
* Ability to develop simple creative concepts and engaging video hooks.
* Good time management and organisational skills.
* Ability to understand feedback and make appropriate revisions.
* Communication skills in Tamil and English.
* A portfolio demonstrating original creative work.

Additional Skills That Will Be an Advantage

* Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or After Effects.
* Product photography and brand videography.
* Motion graphics and advanced editing techniques.
* Social media scheduling tools and basic analytics.
* Copywriting and storytelling.
* Responsible use of AI-assisted tools for creative research, transcription and editing.

Experience with every tool listed above is not mandatory. We prioritise demonstrable ability, creative judgment and willingness to learn.

What We Value

At Bright Blizz, we believe professional growth should be supported by meaningful contributions.

We value individuals who:

* Show initiative rather than waiting for constant instructions.
* Take ownership of work within their experience and responsibilities.
* Understand the purpose behind the content they create.
* Approach challenges with curiosity and practical solutions.
* Respect deadlines, client requirements and professional commitments.
* Strive to improve both creative quality and production efficiency.
* Recognise how effective content contributes to client satisfaction, brand performance and business growth.

We do not expect perfection from day one. We expect consistency, accountability and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Compensation & Performance Review

**Full-Time Employment**

The proposed initial salary range is ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month, with the final offer determined by the candidate's skills, work arrangement and applicable statutory minimum-wage requirements.

The first three months will serve as an initial performance evaluation period.

Performance will be assessed based on:

* Creative quality and originality.
* Practical shooting and editing capabilities.
* Timely completion of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to work independently within approved briefs.
* Consistency with brand guidelines.
* Communication and professional reliability.
* Contribution to production efficiency and client satisfaction.

Compensation may be reviewed following the initial evaluation period based on demonstrated performance, responsibilities and business requirements.

**A salary revision is not automatic or guaranteed.**

**Freelance Opportunities**

We are also open to collaborating with independent content creators on a project basis.

Freelance compensation will be agreed according to the scope of work, shoot requirements, deliverables, timelines and revision allowances.

Freelance applicants should specify their services, availability, portfolio and expected rates.

**Career Development:**

As Bright Blizz expands, successful professionals may have opportunities to take on greater responsibility in:

* Creative content production.
* Brand storytelling and campaign development.
* Social media content strategy.
* Video production and post-production.
* Creative project coordination.

Progression will depend on demonstrated capability, business requirements and available opportunities.

Selection Process

* Resume and portfolio screening.
* Creative and technical interview.
* Short practical assessment, where applicable.
* Final discussion regarding employment arrangement and compensation.

Any substantial production assessment will be appropriately scoped and compensated.

How to Apply

Apply directly through Indeed or send your application to:

**Website:** www.brightblizz.in

Please include your CV, original creative portfolio, links to completed video projects and preferred employment arrangement.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring marketing activities of branch. The role focuses on increasing brand visibility, driving customer footfall and sales, managing campaigns, strengthening customer engagement, controlling marketing costs, and ensuring timely execution of all marketing initiatives. **Candidates from Coimbatore, Tirupur, or nearby areas are highly preferred.**

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Marketing Planning & Strategy**

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing plans aligned with business and sales objectives.
* Plan campaigns for festivals, seasonal sales, new launches, wedding seasons, and promotional activities.
* Identify opportunities to increase customer acquisition, retention, footfall, and sales.
* Set clear objectives and KPIs for every major marketing campaign.

**2. Advertising & Brand Promotion**

* Plan and coordinate advertising across **Newspaper, Outdoor, Digital, Social Media, Radio, and other relevant media**.
* Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and within the approved budget.
* Coordinate with advertising agencies, media partners, printers, and other vendors.
* Monitor competitor campaigns, offers, pricing communication, and promotional activities.
* Measure the effectiveness of different media channels and recommend improvements.

**3. Branch Marketing & Customer Footfall**

* Understand branch-level business requirements and develop suitable local marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers to drive customer footfall and sales.
* Ensure promotional materials and campaigns are implemented correctly at all branches.
* Analyze branch-wise marketing performance and recommend corrective actions.

**4. Campaign & Event Management**

* Plan and execute major campaigns for **Diwali, Pongal, Akshaya Tritiya, Wedding Season, and other key occasions**.
* Coordinate product launches, customer events, promotional events, and special sales campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target customers, budgets, timelines, and expected results.
* Conduct post-campaign reviews and document learnings for future campaigns.

**5. Digital & Social Media Marketing**

* Plan digital campaigns to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, enquiries, and store visits.
* Coordinate with the Digital Marketing and Creative Teams on content, advertisements, offers, and campaigns.
* Monitor impressions, reach, engagement, leads, website traffic, enquiries, and conversions.
* Optimize campaigns based on performance data.

**6. Marketing Budget & Cost Control**

* Prepare and monitor the annual and campaign-wise marketing budget.
* Track actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure marketing activities deliver acceptable returns against the amount spent.
* Negotiate with vendors and agencies to achieve cost-effective execution.
* Review vendor bills and supporting documents before submitting them for approval.

**7. Creative & Marketing Material Management**

* Coordinate the development of **Posters, Banners, Hoardings, Newspaper Ads, Brochures, Standees, Digital Creatives, and other promotional materials**.
* Ensure all creative materials are delivered within agreed timelines.
* Maintain consistency in brand identity and communication.
* Review campaign creatives before release to ensure accuracy and brand compliance.

**8. Market & Competitor Analysis**

* Track competitor advertising, promotions, pricing communication, product launches, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Conduct regular market visits and collect market intelligence.
* Identify emerging customer and market trends.
* Submit actionable recommendations to Management.

**9. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports.
* Track campaign-wise expenditure and results.
* Analyze performance by **Branch, Campaign, Media Channel, Customer Segment, and Promotion**.
* Present marketing performance and key insights to Management.
* Recommend corrective actions where KPIs are below target.

**10. Team & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with **Branch Managers, Sales, Accounts, Purchase, Creative, Digital Marketing, and other Departments**.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor timely completion of marketing activities.
* Maintain a campaign calendar and ensure there are no delays in execution.
* Resolve operational issues affecting campaign delivery.

description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The UI Architect is the single accountable owner of enterprise UI architecture across all products. This person defines the design system, reusable foundation layer, and UI governance model that every product team builds on — enabling consistent, scalable, and intuitive experiences across ERP, POS, OMS, WMS, Reporting, and future modules.

This is a matrix leadership role. The UI Architect does not own product-specific design decisions or engineering implementation — those stay with Product Managers and Engineering respectively. Instead, this role sets the standards, patterns, and governance those decisions must work within, and partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Customer Success to apply them.

This is a hands-on architecture and design leadership role. The person doesn't just define standards on paper — they build reusable component libraries, foundation screens, and research-backed patterns that product teams consume directly.

**What This Role Owns**

* **Enterprise UI/UX architecture:** the long-term design architecture strategy across all products.
* **Enterprise Design System:** tokens, typography, color, spacing, grid, components, patterns, accessibility, and responsive standards — owned and evolved centrally.
* **UI Foundation Layer:** reusable screens and patterns (auth, navigation, dashboards, tables, forms, filters, notifications, empty / loading / error states) that every product consumes.
* **Design capability building:** mentoring UI developers and leads and guiding front-end engineers on usability principles.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* **Product roadmap or feature prioritization:** owned by Product Managers.
* **Product-specific UX decisions:** co-owned with Product Managers within the enterprise design system — this role sets the standards, Product Managers decide the product's specific workflows.
* **Engineering implementation and technology stack decisions:** owned by Engineering Architects; this role ensures designs are aligned with and feasible on the chosen stack.
* **People management of designers embedded in product teams:** reporting model to be confirmed with leadership.
* **Brand identity and marketing collateral:** owned by Marketing/Brand, where such a function exists; this role ensures product UX stays brand-compliant.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise UI/UX Architecture**

* Define the long-term UI architecture strategy across all products and own the scalable enterprise design framework.
* Establish standardized UI principles, reusable interaction models, navigation frameworks, and common user journeys for enterprise workflows.
* Define information architecture standards and a scalable component taxonomy that enables rapid product development.

**UI Foundation Layer**

* Architect and standardize a reusable UI foundation layer — authentication, navigation, search, dashboards, notifications, tables/data grids, forms, filters, pagination, reports, wizards, dialogs, and standard empty/loading/error/success states.
* Ensure this foundation reduces implementation effort for every future product and module.

**Product-Specific UX Partnership**

* Partner with Product Managers to design differentiated experiences for ERP, POS, OMS, WMS, Inventory, Finance, Reporting, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Translate business workflows into intuitive digital experiences within the enterprise design system.

**Technology Alignment**

* Collaborate with Engineering Architects to ensure designs align with the technology stack and are technically scalable.
* Partner with engineering teams through implementation to protect design intent.

**Matrix Collaboration And Leadership**

* Work across Product Management, Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Implementation teams — influencing without direct authority.
* Mentor UI developers, guide front-end engineers, and conduct design workshops to build organizational design capability.

**Continuous Innovation**

* Track industry trends (AI-powered UX, conversational interfaces, design automation, micro-frontends, cross-platform design) and recommend adoption where it strengthens the enterprise experience.

**Required Experience**

14+ years in UI design and architecture, including at least 5+ years leading enterprise design systems.

Experience architecting UI across multiple products in an enterprise SaaS organization.

Deep expertise in design systems, accessibility standards, and interaction pattern architecture.

Strong front-end technical fluency (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Angular/Vue) to credibly partner with engineering.

Experience running UI governance — design reviews, quality gates, and pattern library management.

Experience operating in a matrix organization — influencing Product, Engineering, and Customer Success without direct authority.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred.

**Helpful Experience**

Retail domain experience — POS, ERP, Order Management, Warehouse Management, Omnichannel Retail, e-commerce, or Supply Chain.

Experience with the specific design and front-end tooling in use (Figma, FigJam, Storybook, design tokens, micro-frontend architecture).

Exposure to AI-enabled product experiences and conversational interfaces.

Experience working with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

Ginesys is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. Company: SKS Accessories (pumps and industrial machines manufacturer)

Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Reports To: General Manager / Managing Director

Employment Type: Full-time, permanent

Experience: 2 to 4 years in industrial or manufacturing marketing / technical sales

Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (MBA in Marketing is an advantage)

Salary: Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Marketing Manager takes SKS Accessories pumps and industrial machines to the right customers. This is a technical, business-to-business role designed for a mechanical engineer. The Marketing Manager must understand the products well enough to explain them to dealers, contractors, farmers and industrial buyers, convert enquiries into quotations and orders together with the sales team, and build the SKS brand through catalogues, product demonstrations, exhibitions and digital channels.

The role is hands-on and customer-facing. It combines factory knowledge, technical communication and practical marketing, and works closely with the General Manager, production, quality, design and sales teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Product and Market Knowledge

* Learn every pump and machine in the range in detail, including specifications, performance curves, materials, applications, advantages and limitations.
* Identify target segments and regions such as agriculture, construction, industry, domestic and institutional buyers.
* Study customer needs and buying behaviour, and convert them into clear product positioning and selling points.
* Work with production and design teams to understand new products, upgrades and delivery capacity before promoting them.

2. Technical Marketing Material

* Prepare accurate catalogues, datasheets, brochures, price lists and product comparison sheets.
* Develop product videos, factory tour content, installation references and application case studies with correct technical information.
* Maintain a consistent brand identity (logo, colours, tone and messaging) across all printed and digital material.
* Coordinate with designers, photographers and printers, and ensure timely delivery of material.

3. Enquiry Handling and Sales Support

* Respond to enquiries from calls, website, portals and dealers promptly, and log each lead in a tracking sheet or CRM.
* Prepare technical quotations and proposals together with the sales team and the General Manager.
* Follow up on quotations, understand reasons for won and lost orders, and report findings.
* Track the full journey from enquiry to quotation to order to payment follow-up with the sales team.

4. Dealer and Channel Network

* Identify, appoint and support dealers and distributors in Tamil Nadu and nearby states.
* Plan dealer schemes, promotions and product training sessions on features, installation and service.
* Visit key dealers and customers regularly, collect market feedback and strengthen relationships.
* Maintain a dealer database with sales performance, outstanding follow-ups and support needs.

5. Customer Visits, Demonstrations and Tenders

* Support site visits, factory visits and live product demonstrations that build buyer confidence.
* Collect testimonials, installation photos and references from satisfied customers.
* Support quotations, documentation and submissions for government, industrial and institutional tenders.

6. Exhibitions and Events

* Plan SKS participation in trade fairs, agricultural and industrial exhibitions, and dealer meets.
* Manage stall design, sample products, printed material, staffing and logistics within the approved budget.
* Capture leads at events and follow up within an agreed time.

7. Digital and Online Presence

* Manage the company website, LinkedIn page, Instagram, Facebook and Google Business profile with regular technical and factory content.
* Maintain product listings on B2B portals such as IndiaMART and respond to portal leads.
* Run paid campaigns on Google and Meta within budget, and apply basic SEO to improve search visibility.
* Track website visits, enquiries and campaign cost, and improve what works.

8. Market Intelligence and Planning

* Track competitor products, pricing, schemes and promotions, and share a regular summary with management.
* Prepare a monthly and annual marketing plan with targets and budget, and review progress against it.
* Share customer and dealer feedback with production and design to support product improvements.

9. Reporting and Coordination

* Submit a monthly report covering enquiries, quotations, orders won, lead sources, campaign spend and key learnings.
* Coordinate with accounts, dispatch and service teams so customers receive a smooth experience after the order.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (essential). An MBA in Marketing is an added advantage.
* 2 to 4 years of experience in industrial or manufacturing marketing or technical sales, preferably with pumps, motors, machinery or engineering goods.
* Experience working with dealers, distributors, contractors or industrial buyers is preferred.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

Technical and Functional

* Strong mechanical fundamentals and the ability to read technical drawings, specifications and performance data.
* Ability to prepare technical quotations and explain product benefits to non-technical customers.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, basic SEO and design tools such as Canva; basic video editing is an advantage.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets, email and CRM or lead tracking.

**Behavioural**

* Clear communication in English and Tamil, both written and spoken (Hindi is an advantage).
* Confident negotiation and relationship-building with dealers and customers.
* Self-driven, organised and able to manage several follow-ups and campaigns at once.
* Willingness to travel to dealers, customers and exhibitions.
* Team player who works well with production, sales and management.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Number of qualified enquiries per month
* Enquiry-to-quotation and quotation-to-order conversion
* Orders from new dealers and new customers
* Cost per lead and return on marketing spend
* Quality and timeliness of marketing material and reports
* Growth in website, portal and social media enquiries

**AUTHORITY AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Spends marketing budget and commits to vendors within limits approved by the General Manager.
* Prices, discounts, dealer terms and tenders require management approval.
* Based at the factory in Coimbatore, with regular travel for dealer visits, customer demonstrations and exhibitions.
* Working hours may extend during exhibitions, campaigns and peak dispatch periods.

**COMPENSATION**

Salary of Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month, based on experience and skills, along with statutory benefits as per company policy. Travel expenses for official visits are reimbursed as per company policy.
